description: Na₂NiInF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one InF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent InF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.52 Å. Ni is bonded to six F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent InF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent InF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are a spread of Ni-F bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.03 Å. In is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted InF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. There are a spread of In-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.52 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one In atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one In atom to form FNa₃In tetrahedra that share corners with ten FNa₃In tetrahedra and edges with three FNa₂InNi tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one In atom to form FNa₃In tetrahedra that share corners with ten FNa₃In tetrahedra and edges with three FNa₂InNi tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ni, and one In atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂InNi tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one In atom.
